differences.what: Red cabinet side panel: B carries a dark-to-light reflection gradient that models the acrylic as a solid glass slab with depth; A's side is flat, evenly lit pink-red and reads as a tinted sheet
Water-clear side panel: B shows a darker reflected band giving edge definition and volume; A's side washes out into the white set, so the box loses its right-hand edge
Black cabinet: B holds more shadow detail (crushed pixels 2.1% vs 8.3%, p95 166 vs 148) so the interior bracing and side face stay readable; A plugs up to a dead black mass
A's red side shows the internal side bracing more clearly through the panel, slightly better explaining the construction
